Take 14 days. 15 mins, just 15 mins daily on English Seekho. By the end of this month, you will be speaking English. Learning English is not difficult, starting is. First week, watch experts' videos. They teach English by explaining in Hindi. Short 2 to 5-minute videos, so easy that you'll feel 'I can do this too'. Second week, practice with AI coach. Disha Ma'am is available 24 hours. Even at 5 AM, or 12 AM. Chat or send a voice message, Disha Ma'am will reply. If you speak wrong, she will correct you. Speak wrong 100 times, she will correct you 100 times. She will never laugh, never judge, never say 'you don't even know this'. Private, safe, at your speed. You won't be perfect in 14 days, I won't lie. But you will be able to speak, without stopping, without fear, without shyness. Trial only ₹1. No excuses now, only practice. So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]

An AI robot presenter then introduces the 'English Seekho' app, explaining its 14-day learning structure featuring expert videos and a 24/7 AI coach named Disha.
